ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels constitute approximately 85% of the surface area, with low-intensity black pixels localized to the trailing edge and peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes. Low-intensity black band along the trailing edge boundary. Focal dark cluster at the median notch extending into the peduncle. One isolated small dark vertical elliptical blotch located on the midline in the lower third of the fluke.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-amplitude, low-frequency serrations along the trailing edge; the topography is relatively smooth with minor irregular pixel deviations concentrated toward the lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory for both lobes, curving upwards and outwards to sharp lateral terminals.

other_distinctive_markers: A singular, well-defined vertical dark pigment spot located on the central longitudinal axis approximately 20% above the peduncle insertion.
